AIIMS NORCET 10th Seat Allotment Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : All India Institute of Medical Science AIIMS has released the Seat Allotment Result for the Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test 2026 (NORCET-10th) on its official website. This recruitment was released for 2551 posts. Applications for the AIIMS NORCET 10th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 24 February 2026, to 16 March 2026. The Stage II examination was conducted on 30 April 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their AIIMS NORCET 10th Seat Allotment Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 February 2026
  • Last Date : 16 March 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 March 2026
  • Stage-I Exam Date : 11 April 2026
  • Stage-I Exam City Details : 04 April 2026
  • Stage-I Admit Card : 08 April 2026
  • Stage-I Result : 16 April 2026
  • Stage-II Exam Date : 30 April 2026
  • Stage-II Admit Card : 29 April 2026
  • Stage-II Result : 12 May 2026
  • Seat Alotment Result : 14 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
